figurative_meaning_en: Ignorant; very young; lacking knowledge; utterly childish
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এখনও গলা টিপলে দুধ বেরোয়, এতটাই অজ্ঞ।
বাচ্চাটা গলা টিপলে দুধ বেরোয় মতো নির্দোষ।
example_sentences_in_english: He is still so naive that if you squeezed his throat, milk would come out.
The child is as innocent as if milk would flow from his throat if squeezed.
note: This idiom evokes imagery of infancy, common in oral Bengali traditions to describe extreme youthfulness.
